description.value: Himalaya Restaurant is an Indian cuisine chain with locations in Vancouver and Richmond, BC. The Vancouver outpost sits on Main Street and offers online ordering. Touring cyclists in the Main Street corridor will find it a convenient stop for a sit-down Indian meal.

The OSM website field is a Google redirect URL rather than the canonical domain.
